item.title: Machine Learning Local Potentials for Accelerated Electron-Phonon Interactions Calculations within the Projector Augmented-Wave Framework
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yi Xia
arXiv:2609.01923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-phonon interactions govern carrier dynamics, transport, and many optical and quantum phenomena in solids, but finite-displacement calculations within the projector augmented-wave (PAW) framework require up to 6N self-consistent supercell calculations for an N-atom system, making them costly for large, low-symmetry, and disordered materials. We introduce MLLocP, a machine learning strategy that learns the self-consistent local potential on real-space grids and supplies its displacement derivatives to the evaluation of all-electron PAW electron-phonon matrix elements. Analysis of the PAW decomposition identifies the local-potential contribution as a natural target for machine learning, while the remaining PAW quantities are retained w…

item.title: 复空间中实约束神经网络的局限与容量
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Andrew Gracyk
该工作比较在同一复假设类中强制预激活为实数与允许复预激活时的存储容量，并给出二者的渐近比值。作者采用来自复高斯分布的权重，其范数几乎必然渐近收敛到维度平方根，并通过临界容量处的 Gardner 体积型比较展开分析。证明中使用了 Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber 公式以及 Weyl 积分公式和 Haar 测度，对酉群和正交群上的积分给出更稳健的渐近近似。

item.title: 面向量子隐形传态与超密编码的神经网络误差缓解
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Hritik Chaudhary, Gokul K.C.
该论文研究小型神经网络作为纯经典后处理层，能否在接收端仅获得有限测量结果且未知噪声参数的条件下缓解量子通信协议误差。作者用复量子比特振幅的张量运算精确实现量子隐形传态和超密编码，并引入信道与读出等现实缺陷进行有限采样评估。结果显示，学习方法的收益存在边界：在低采样超密编码场景中可优于多数投票基线，而在系统性门失准等情形下也可学习一定的误差反演。

item.title: Deep learning of position-dependent diffusivity from umbrella sampling molecular dynamics simulations
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
A widely used computational framework to calculate the membrane permeability coefficient of small molecules is the inhomogeneous solubility-diffusion (ISD) model. It requires two ingredients that can be calculated using molecular dynamics simulations: the potential of mean force, which is well-defined, and the position-dependent diffusivity, which is often problematic and challenging. Two methods (Woolf–Roux and Hummer) have been proposed to determine the position-dependent diffusivity profiles using biased umbrella sampling simulations. While both are constructed from similar time-correlation functions, they can disagree quantitatively. arXiv:2609.02263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report on the emergence of the anomalous (paramagnetic) superfluid response in altermagnetic superconductors at arbitrary impurity concentrations. arXiv:2609.02767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. 作者提出一类混合宇称滑移多铁材料，其中自发铁电极化通过层间滑移与若干非相对论自旋劈裂分量耦合，使这些分量可被电学方式可逆切换。对称性分析表明共面磁体是实现该机制的天然平台，第一性原理计算进一步以双层 VBr₂ 为代表，展示了面外铁电极化与偶宇称、奇宇称非相对论自旋劈裂符号的协同反转。相关自旋劈裂符号被锁定到可滑移切换的铁电极化，并可由自旋流响应编码，为低能非易失逻辑器件扩展了滑移铁电与滑移多铁功能。

item.title: 通过应变消除费米口袋在 d 波交替磁体中实现近乎完全的电荷—自旋转换
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wancheng Zhang, Fangqi Liu, Yong Liu, Jingguo Hu, Zhihong Lu, Rui Xiong, Zhenhua Zhang
理想 d 波交替磁体的近正交平坦费米面可实现完全自旋通道分离和理论上 100% 的电荷—自旋转换效率，但实际 KV₂Se₂O 中残余椭圆费米口袋会增强电荷电导并压低自旋电导。第一性原理计算表明，面内等双轴拉伸应变可系统消除这些寄生口袋并恢复平带几何，使转换效率随应变单调升高，在 4% 应变下达到约 96%。紧束缚模型确认口袋抑制主要由次近邻跃迁减小驱动；同一机制还可产生非常规面外自旋流分量，并显著增强 KV₂Se₂O 基磁隧道结的隧穿磁阻。

item.title: Making superconductors thinner can change how they accommodate magnetic fields
item.description:
📚 Physics News
What happens when a superconductor becomes so thin that electrons can no longer behave as if they were moving through an ordinary three-dimensional piece of metal? This question has been at the center of my recent work on quantum confinement in metallic films. Over the past few years, I have been developing this line of theory with my colleague Giovanni Ummarino at Politecnico di Torino. Our initial goal was to understand something rather concrete: Why does shrinking the thickness of a superconducting film change the temperature at which superconductivity appears?

该文提出一种平滑分析框架，以规避传统监督学习中即使简单概念类也可能难以学习的强硬性结果。学习器不再与任意最优分类器竞争，而是与对小高斯随机扰动鲁棒的最佳分类器竞争，由此可学习依赖低维子空间且具有有界高斯表面积的广泛概念类。该类包括半空间函数和低维凸集等，在非平滑设置下通常只在高斯等高度结构化分布上有可学习性结果。
